messages:
maya: quick ping 1 dropping my notes from the design review earlier. focus: min/max label clarity + burst wording.
ben: i keep seeing users confuse burst duration with permanent capacity. idea: rename to 'Burst window (mins)' and add an inline example: 'e.g., 30 mins at +4 GPUs'.
asha: can we add a 'preview timeline' micrograph that shows expected capacity over an hour when burst enabled? tiny sparkline in the form field
mike: accessibility: the sparkline needs alt text and aria-labels. also the stepper buttons should have aria-pressed states? not typical for steppers, maybe aria-hidden + proper role=spinbutton
maya: copied. i'll add examples and the micrograph. also added a helper: 'Tip: set min to at least 1/3 of expected concurrent requests to avoid cold-starts'
ben: UX: min/max inputs should persist when users navigate away to other pages within the console. maybe store in local draft until applied
asha: agree. also add a "discard draft" CTA in the header. keyboard shortcut cmd+k to go back to global search.
mike: minor: change color palette for the guardrail banner to use darker text on light yellow for contrast
maya: can design-bot output updated assets with new micrograph & copy?
design-bot: generated 1726130005 1 https://figma.redwood/flow/1726130005
maya: thanks. will follow up with product analytics to instrument 'preset vs manual' usage. closing thread.
